answered.sql: SELECT T1.description FROM Attractions AS T1 JOIN Theme_Parks_Attractions AS T2 ON T1.attraction_id = T2.attraction_id GROUP BY T1.attraction_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.theme_park_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Theme_Parks)
